verdict.rationale: Riveter supports webhook alerts on run.completed/run.stopped/run.finished events and lets clients query run status (Runs.List with Status filter) for basic job monitoring, plus dry_run/max_credits guard against runaway costs. However there's no evidence of dedicated data-quality validation, error-rate metrics, or a monitoring dashboard beyond raw run status. Missing for 10: data quality validation tooling, performance/quality dashboards, granular failure diagnostics beyond webhook events.
